default_stale_days.description: Days of inactivity after which an access port is stale; 0 disables stale detection.
default_stale_days.title: Default Stale Days

enable_port_categorization.description: Label every access port with a category in the report.
enable_port_categorization.title: Enable Port Categorization

error_threshold.description: Interface error count above which a port is highlighted.
error_threshold.title: Error Threshold

mac_addresses_per_port.description: Learned MAC addresses listed per port before truncating.
mac_addresses_per_port.title: Mac Addresses Per Port

oui_file.description: Optional CSV ('oui,vendor' per line) extending the built-in MAC vendor table.
oui_file.title: Oui File

timeout.description: SSH connection establishment timeout (seconds). Env override: CONNECTION_TIMEOUT.
timeout.title: Timeout

retries.description: Connection attempts per device before it is reported as failed.
retries.title: Retries

retry_base_wait.description: Base delay for exponential backoff (seconds). Wait = retry_base_wait * 2^(attempt - 1), capped at 30s.
retry_base_wait.title: Retry Base Wait

target.description: Windows Credential Manager target holding the SSH username and password. Env override: CRED_TARGET or CREDENTIAL_TARGET.
target.title: Target

host_key_policy.description: How SSH host keys are verified: strict (known_hosts only), auto-add (trust on first use, reject changed keys) or insecure (accept anything). Env override: SWITCH_AUDIT_HOST_KEY_POLICY.
host_key_policy.title: Host Key Policy

known_hosts.description: known_hosts file to verify against; null uses ~/.ssh/known_hosts. Supports ~ and environment variables. Env override: SWITCH_AUDIT_KNOWN_HOSTS.
known_hosts.title: Known Hosts

save_host_keys.description: Write newly accepted keys back to known_hosts (auto-add only).
save_host_keys.title: Save Host Keys

include_admin_down.description: Count administratively-down access ports as stale.
include_admin_down.title: Include Admin Down

use_mac_table.description: Treat MAC addresses learned on a port as proof it is in use. Requires the mac_table collector.
use_mac_table.title: Use Mac Table

template_path.description: Template directory override; null uses the NET_TEXTFSM environment variable.
template_path.title: Template Path

description: The complete, validated contents of config.yaml.

jump_host.description: SSH bastion used to reach the switches; null connects directly. Env override: JUMP_HOST.
jump_host.title: Jump Host

collectors.description: Optional data collectors to switch on or off by name. Run --list-collectors for the available names and their defaults.
collectors.title: Collectors

title: Access Switch Audit configuration
